What is MicFi? A digital agency for growing businesses

MicFi October 22, 2026 MicFi

MicFi is a digital agency that designs and builds websites, web and desktop applications, and management systems for growing businesses that want to run better and be easier to find online.

What we build

  • Websites that load fast, work on a phone, and tell people clearly what you do.
  • Web and desktop applications for the work that spreadsheets cannot handle.
  • Management systems such as point of sale, HR, and multi-branch retail tools.

Where we are

Our base is Kansanga, Kampala. We work with clients in person or remotely, whichever suits you.

How we work

We start by learning how your business actually runs. Then we agree the scope, build in short stages, and stay available after launch. No jargon and no surprise invoices.

The MicFi name

MicFi is the name we build under, and the same name you will see on our systems, from MicFi POS to MicFi HR. As the business has grown, the focus has moved to websites, applications, and management systems for shops, teams, and growing companies.

Talk to MicFi

If you need a website, an app, or a system for your business, get in touch. You can also see what we do and the systems we are building.
